title: Bleached corals thrive within days when touching healthy neighbour
summary: Researchers discovered that bleached corals can recover within days when physically touching healthy neighbor corals, with heat-stressed corals showing accelerated recovery when in contact with resilient partners. The study conducted in the Florida Keys reveals a potential 'physical rescue' mechanism that could inform coral reef conservation strategies.
problem_solved: Addresses the global coral reef bleaching crisis by identifying a natural recovery mechanism where healthy corals can help neighboring bleached corals survive heat stress.
why_valuable: This discovery offers a promising, nature-based solution for coral reef restoration efforts and provides hope for ecosystem recovery under climate change.
